name: browserwright-search-remote
label: Google via remote CloakBrowser
_note: The same runner as `browserwright-search`, pointed at a remote CDP endpoint
through options.sessionArgs (the argv after `browserwright session new`).
See that declaration for the extractor and failWhen rationale.
Inert until BW_REMOTE_CDP is set: an unset variable reports `missing env
BW_REMOTE_CDP` before any session is created.
Ordered after the local rung, so it runs when your Chrome cannot answer (no
extension, a captcha on your IP). Move it first in config.json
timeoutMs is 240s: the endpoint may queue the connection for a couple of
minutes at its concurrency limit, on top of the 10-21s a Google SERP costs.
